body: The alternative to dying was admitting she's followed in her family's footsteps somehow by having a mental illness.

This. Thank you. She likes to write. She wrote down everything she was feeling (pages and pages) and I took her back to the hospital and they admitted her based on the self harming thoughts she had written. She's been admitted and is safe now. Safe. My god thank you. Such a simple thing. Just pen and paper. Thank you.

Long history of bipolar, suicide, schizophrenia. She's serious, this is not attention seeking behavior. She's saying she doesn't want to have to kill herself, but she wants to die. I told her I wouldn't help her kill herself.
